text:
ivy: Quick catch from the SDK rollout smoke: several docs still show `max_tokens` and the legacy `function_call` object. Also found mismatched grpc snippets in the OpenAPI + gRPC examples.

samir: can you list a few paths? i'll take gRPC + openapi examples.

ivy: `docs/snippets/grpc/generate.proto#L22`, `docs/openapi/server_examples.md` code blocks, and `guides/migrations/v1-to-v2.md` (the JSON examples). There's also `docs/redirects/deprecate_map.yaml` referencing old anchors.

clare: i can handle redirects and anchors. changing param names bumped a few headings and the redirect map needs updated target anchors. i'll run docs-linter check-anchors after changes.

oscar: i'll update gRPC proto snippets to show the new field name and the tool_calls array shape. note: proto change is just docs — runtime kept proto backward-compat temporarily, but Dedicated enforces the new keys. add a note in the migration guide.

samir: for OpenAPI examples i will update the request body samples and the schema references, and add a small FAQ about test fixtures: JSON key renames can break snapshots.

ivy: new deprecation copy proposal: "Support for legacy `max_tokens` and the `function_call` object will be removed on 2026-09-01. Please migrate by 2026-08-15." run that by PM/legal.

clare: FYI changing the redirect map affects a few legacy URLs used in customer KBs. i'll coordinate with CS to post temporary redirects.

oscar: small grammar/sample I'll commit in the proto example: show OLD vs NEW and emphasize that `tool_calls` is an array (servers may return multiple tool calls in future).

samir: added a short codemod note for maintainers: use `jscodeshift` for JS/TS, `ruff`+`sed` for py, and a tiny jq transform for JSON fixtures. I'll include examples in the PR descriptions.

ios: ops-bot: snippets PRs opened: 9211 (grpc), 9212 (openapi), 9213 (redirects). CI: lint + smoke tests queued.

docs-ci: docs build queued https://deploys.redwood-inference.com/builds/9123; note: anchor-check step will fail if redirects not updated.

clare: merged redirects PR after updating `docs/redirects/deprecate_map.yaml` and adding temporary fallback anchors. ran `docs-linter check-anchors` locally.

oscar: merged grpc + openapi PRs, added proto snippet before/after, and a short note for integrators about streaming vs unary behavior for tool payloads.

samir: i'll update the migration guide with a short checklist: update param names, update test fixtures and snapshots, run snippet smoke tests, update redirects map, and notify CS + support.

ivy: one more: our internal evals flagged a token accounting difference in a few regression tests because the SDK uses the new `max_output_tokens` semantics. i'll add a note to the evals owner to rebaseline.

clare: posting a small runbook for support: steps to triage a customer report (check if they're on Dedicated, check code for `max_tokens`, guide them to the codemod & KB).

ios: docs-bot: banner draft prepared and staged; will publish after PM signoff and once builds pass.

ivY: thanks everyone. plan: merge in 48h, publish banner within 72h after merge, and schedule a docs rebuild + sticky KB update.

(THREAD END)
